{{Quote|There is a vast asteroid field nearby, far too large to simply destroy. We believe they are hiding somewhere within.|[[Galactic Emperor|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]], to [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]]|<ref name="SWA" />}}
A vast '''asteroid field''' lay at some point along the [[Corellian Trade Spine/Legends|Corellian Trade Spine]]. At the center of the [[Asteroid field/Legends|asteroid field]] lay the [[Planetoid/Legends|planetoid]] [[Annamar]]. During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], elements of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] conducted raids on [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Convoy/Legends|convoys]] along the Corellian Trade Spine, striking from within the [[Asteroid/Legends|asteroid]] field.
